instruction: Edit the _config.yaml in ~/Code/Website by setting the title field to 'Academic Portfolio' and the description field to 'Research and Publications'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to update top-level site configuration fields in the YAML file. The agent must locate the 'title' field (at line 11) and 'description' field (at line 14) in _config.yml and update them to 'Academic Portfolio' and 'Research and Publications' respectively. The evaluator uses the existing check_json metric with is_yaml=true to verify these two top-level fields. The task maintains similar complexity to the original - finding and editing YAML configuration values.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly fetches the YAML configuration file from the VM after ensuring it is saved via postconfig (Ctrl+S)
Metric check_json with is_yaml=true correctly loads and validates YAML files
Complete coverage: Both instruction requirements (title and description fields) are verified
Expected values are semantically correct: 'Academic Portfolio' for title and 'Research and Publications' for description match the instruction exactly
Validation logic uses appropriate exact match comparison (method: 'eq') for both fields
Edge cases handled: check_json returns 0.0 if file is None, doesn't exist, or has YAML parsing errors
Postconfig appropriately executes Ctrl+S to save any open file in the editor before verification
The static warning about type compatibility is a false positive: get_vm_file returns a string path when multi=False (default), which is compatible with check_json's str parameter

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
